en.title: Agent Zero Memory: Provenance-Aware Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents
en.hook: Build faithful, long-term memory systems for LLM agents that track provenance beyond simple fact stores.
key_takeaways: Flexible agent memory management overcoming single-structure limits
Accurate and persistent context maintenance for enterprise environments
